_meta.description: Stage 1 (Registered) for the Anaplan Overview foundational journey. Universal entry-point — every partner resource completes this regardless of intended persona. Stripped-down vs per-application Stage 1: no primary-focus task, no parent-journey enrollment, no prereq verification (this IS the prereq).

_note: Stage 1 task structure for foundational Anaplan Overview journey.
name: Registered
description: Resource confirms journey understanding, partner portal access, expanded resource profile, and Partner Success engagement model.

tasks.title: Review Anaplan Overview Journey roadmap & expectations
tasks.description: Walk through the 3 stages of the Anaplan Overview journey, what's covered in each, and how this foundational journey routes you to your persona-specific Foundations journey on completion. Sets expectations before any other work begins.

tasks.title: Complete resource profile
tasks.description: Capture firm, intended role declaration (Sales / Pre-Sales / Delivery / undecided), region and language coverage, prior Anaplan exposure, and manager contact info (name, email, role). The role declaration is provisional — the final pathway is confirmed at Stage 3 exit.
tasks._profile_field_spec_status: draft — foundational profile spec is a subset of persona-specific specs; locked as separate work item

tasks.title: Understand how to engage Anaplan Partner Success
tasks.description: Review the Partner Success engagement model — how to raise tickets, which Slack channels apply, and how to use the Partner Success agent. Same content surfaced in per-application journey Stage 1; foundational-stage exposure ensures every resource knows the path before they need it.

gates.description: Anaplan Overview Journey roadmap reviewed and acknowledged
Resource profile complete with intended-role declaration and required fields populated

_stage_exit_actions_note: No system-side actions on Stage 1 exit.
_estimated_effort_total_note: Roughly 30 min lighter than per-application Stage 1 because there's no primary-focus task, parent-journey enrollment, or prereq verification.
